author: Rogue Hobbies
description:
We all love Painting Warhammer and Miniatures and all of that jazz right? Its fun, creative and often even kinda relaxing too ... until it isn't... 

I think its fair to say that sometimes mini painting and improving your skills in the hobby can be QUITE HARD! Theres Techniques to learn which some painters make look easy and paint consistencies which can be hard to visualise whilst sat at home! 

Well Recently I asked you guys to tell me ALL of these which really make you struggle so I could make THIS VIDEO! THE BIG MINI PAINTING FAQ! And hopefully I as a seasoned painted myself, can shed a bit of light on all of your burning painting questions! 

________ 

CHAPTERS!

00:00 - Intro!
02:26 - Glazing? 
03:24 - Wet Blending?
06:25 - Paint Thinning? 
09:01 - Cleaning Brushes?
09:49 - How do I paint X like GW?
11:39 - Drybrushing?
14:04 - Smooths Blends WITHOUT an Airbrush?
15:06 - Clean Washes and Shades?
17:09 - Smooth Paintjobs?
18:45 - Dealing with Burn-out? 
20:50 - How to paint COLO
title: I Answered All of Your BIGGEST Miniature Painting Questions! | The BIG PAINTING FAQ!
